screens.large: In Phase 1, Sofia works with the client to understand the brief, assess the site, develop the design, and confirm the budget and approvals needed to build.

screens.screenSummary: Confirm the essentials: the client's brief, the site conditions, and a clear budget.

nodes.title: Client Brief
nodes.content: Sit down with the client to capture the vision, requirements, and priorities for the project.

nodes.title: Site Survey
nodes.content: Survey the plot for levels, soil, boundaries, and existing services, to understand exactly what we're building on.

nodes.title: In-House Design
nodes.content: Sofia's own design and engineering team develops the drawings, 3D visuals, and specifications in-house, keeping design and build under one roof.

screens.screenSummary: Start early on cost, programme, and the authority approvals every UAE project needs.

nodes.title: Project Programme
nodes.content: Set out the construction stages and timeline so every trade and delivery is sequenced from day one.

nodes.title: Authority Engagement
nodes.content: Engage early with the municipality, civil defence, and utility providers (DEWA / ADDC) to confirm what each will require.

nodes.title: Cost Plan & Estimate
nodes.content: Price the works in detail: a transparent cost plan the client can rely on before committing to build.

nodes.title: Value Engineering
nodes.content: Sofia reviews the design for smarter methods, materials, and sequencing that protect quality while reducing cost and time.

screens.screenSummary: Confirm the design, approvals, and sustainability goals before breaking ground.

nodes.title: Design Approvals
nodes.content: Submit the design for building permit and authority approvals, and resolve comments to reach a permit to build.

nodes.title: Sustainable Design
nodes.content: Set the client's sustainability goals, whether Estidama Pearl, LEED, or energy efficiency, and build them into the design.

nodes.title: Approvals & NOCs
nodes.content: Coordinate NOCs and clearances from every stakeholder, including utilities, telecoms, and neighbouring plots, to keep the programme moving.

nodes.title: Method Statements
nodes.content: Sofia prepares construction method statements and risk assessments in-house so work starts safely and to spec.

nodes.title: Site Investigation
nodes.content: Where needed, Sofia carries out soil and geotechnical investigation to confirm the foundation design before construction.

screens.large: In Phase 2, permits are secured and the supply chain is built, awarding trades and ordering materials so construction can start on time.

blocks.heading: Building Permit Application
blocks.content: Submit the approved design to the municipality for a building permit, with all drawings and calculations.

blocks.heading: Utility Applications
blocks.content: Apply to DEWA / ADDC and telecom providers for the power, water, and connectivity the project will need.

blocks.heading: Authority Approvals Secured
blocks.content: Civil defence, municipality, and utility approvals are issued and fees settled, clearing the way to build.

blocks.heading: Long-Lead Procurement
blocks.content: Order long-lead items early, from lifts and chillers to façade and bespoke joinery, so they never hold up the programme.

blocks.heading: Contracts & Insurances
blocks.content: Put the main contract, warranties, and project insurances in place, confirming scope and responsibility for all parties.

blocks.heading: Trade Package Scoping
blocks.content: Break the works into clear trade packages for structure, MEP, façade, and finishes, ready to tender.

blocks.heading: Tender & Award
blocks.content: Invite trusted subcontractors to tender, compare on price and capability, and award each package.

blocks.heading: Subcontractor Onboarding
blocks.content: Vet and onboard each subcontractor for track record, safety, and capacity, then sign the trade contracts.

blocks.heading: Material Procurement
blocks.content: Finalise orders for key materials and equipment, locking in prices and delivery dates against the programme.

screens.heading: Enabling Works
screens.content: Sofia can start early with enabling works like site setup, hoarding, temporary services, and shoring, so groundworks begin the moment approvals land.

screens.large: In Phase 3, Sofia mobilises on site and builds, from foundations and structure to the building envelope, with quality and safety managed daily.

screens.screenSummary: Break ground: set out the site, build the foundations, and raise the main structure.

nodes.title: Foundations & Substructure
nodes.content: Excavate, lay foundations, and build the substructure, the base every project depends on, set out and checked to the millimetre.

nodes.title: Main Structure
nodes.content: Sofia's own crews raise the main structure, from concrete frame to columns and slabs, self-delivered for full control over quality and pace.

screens.screenSummary: Enclose the building: structure, envelope, and first-fix services take shape.

nodes.title: Site Mobilisation
nodes.content: Sofia sets up the site with crews, plant, welfare, and safety, and gets materials flowing to the workface.

nodes.title: Blockwork & Partitions
nodes.content: Subcontractors build internal and external walls, defining every room and space within the structure.

nodes.title: MEP First Fix
nodes.content: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services are routed through the structure, the hidden network behind every wall and ceiling.

nodes.title: Material Delivery
nodes.content: Sofia coordinates deliveries of key materials and equipment to site, just in time for each stage of work.

nodes.title: Envelope & Façade
nodes.content: The building envelope goes up with roofing, cladding, windows, and façade, sealing the structure against the weather.

screens.large: In Phase 4, the building is fitted out: services completed, finishes installed, and every system tested and commissioned.

blocks.heading: MEP Second Fix
blocks.content: With walls and ceilings closed up, MEP teams install fixtures and terminals: sockets, lights, taps, and grilles.

blocks.heading: Temporary Services (Optional)
blocks.content: Where needed, temporary power and water keep fit-out moving until permanent services are energised.

blocks.heading: Internal Finishes
blocks.content: Plaster, paint, flooring, tiling, and joinery bring each space to life, room by room.

blocks.heading: Utilities Energised
blocks.content: Permanent power and water are connected and live, and the building runs on its own services.

blocks.heading: Testing & Commissioning
blocks.content: Every system, from electrical and HVAC to plumbing and life-safety, is tested and commissioned to prove it performs.

blocks.heading: External Works & Landscaping
blocks.content: Driveways, hardscaping, pools, and landscaping complete the setting around the finished building.

screens.large: In Phase 5, the project is snagged, cleaned, and handed over, and Sofia stays on for warranty and aftercare.

screens.screenSummary: Hand over a finished project: snag-free, certified, and backed by ongoing support.

nodes.title: Aftercare & Maintenance
nodes.content: Sofia stays on after handover, with a defects-liability warranty and optional maintenance to keep the building in top condition.

nodes.title: Sustainability Delivered
nodes.content: The sustainability targets set at design, from Estidama and LEED to efficiency, are verified and certified at completion.

nodes.title: Snagging & Handover
nodes.content: Sofia's team walks the project, closes every snag, and hands over keys, warranties, and O&M manuals to the client.

screens.large: The project is complete and handed over. Step inside to see how everything comes together, from structure and finishes to systems, comfort, and sustainability.

blocks.heading: Security & Access
blocks.content: Layered security, from access control and CCTV to smart-home integration, keeps the building and everyone in it safe.

blocks.heading: Smart Building Systems
blocks.content: Building-management systems tie lighting, climate, and security together, controllable from a single dashboard.

blocks.heading: HVAC & Airflow
blocks.content: HVAC systems circulate and filter fresh air, holding a comfortable, healthy climate throughout the building.

blocks.heading: Cooling Systems
blocks.content: Efficient chillers and air-conditioning keep every room at the right temperature, even in peak UAE summer heat.

blocks.heading: Power Distribution
blocks.content: This is where utility power enters the building and is distributed safely to every circuit, panel, and room.

blocks.heading: Connectivity & Fibre
blocks.content: High-speed fibre and structured cabling connect the building to the world, carrying internet, TV, and smart devices throughout.

blocks.heading: Backup Power
blocks.content: Standby generators and UPS stand ready to keep essential systems running the moment mains power drops.

blocks.heading: Energy Management
blocks.content: Smart metering and controls balance loads and trim consumption, for lower bills and a lighter footprint.

blocks.heading: Living & Working Spaces
blocks.content: Bedrooms, offices, kitchens, and majlis are finished and furnished, spaces designed around how people actually live and work.

blocks.heading: Comfort & Detailing
blocks.content: It's the details that make a space: level floors, crisp joinery, and finishes that feel right underfoot and to the touch.

blocks.heading: Sustainability
blocks.content: Solar panels, efficient systems, and smart controls cut energy use, for an Estidama-minded building that costs less to run.

blocks.heading: Water & Efficiency
blocks.content: Low-flow fixtures and greywater reuse cut water waste, with irrigation tuned for a desert climate.

blocks.heading: Estidama Pearl Rating
blocks.content: Design and build to the UAE's Estidama Pearl Rating System, hitting the sustainability targets set for the project.

blocks.heading: LEED Certification
blocks.content: Deliver to LEED standards where the client wants globally recognised green-building certification.

blocks.heading: Energy-Efficient MEP
blocks.content: High-efficiency chillers, LED lighting, and smart controls that cut running costs for the life of the building.

blocks.heading: Solar PV & Battery
blocks.content: Rooftop solar and battery storage to generate clean power on site and reduce reliance on the grid.

blocks.heading: Sustainable Materials
blocks.content: Low-carbon concrete, responsibly sourced timber, and regional materials that lower the project's footprint.

blocks.heading: Water Efficiency
blocks.content: Low-flow fixtures, greywater reuse, and climate-tuned irrigation to save water in a desert environment.

blocks.heading: Smart Building Management
blocks.content: A building-management system that monitors and optimises energy and water use automatically, day and night.

GasCapabilities.title: Sofia's Self-Delivery Capabilities
GasCapabilities.intro: Sofia self-performs core trades with its own crews and equipment, keeping quality, cost, and programme under one roof across residential and commercial projects.

rows: Concrete & Structure:
In-house crews for foundations, concrete frames, and structural works.
Blockwork & Finishes:
Directly delivered masonry, plaster, and finishing trades.
MEP Coordination:
Managed mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works across every discipline.
Direct Labour:
Our own skilled workforce means fewer handoffs and tighter control on site.
Cost Certainty:
Self-delivery removes subcontractor mark-ups and reduces the risk of delay claims.

blocks.title: Projects across the UAE
blocks.content: From villas and residential compounds to commercial and retail fit-out, Sofia delivers projects across the Emirates.

RetailOfferings.title: Aftercare & Maintenance
RetailOfferings.intro: Ongoing support after handover, from the defects-liability period to long-term maintenance

blocks.title: Support tailored to how the client uses the building:
rows: Defects Liability:
A warranty period after handover during which Sofia fixes any defects at no cost.
Maintenance Contracts:
Optional annual maintenance covering MEP servicing, HVAC, and general upkeep.
Warranties & O&M:
Manufacturer warranties and operation & maintenance manuals handed over in full.
Responsive Callouts:
A single point of contact for snags and callouts long after the keys are handed over.

blocks.content:
Self-delivery means Sofia performs the work directly with its own in-house crews, plant, and equipment, rather than passing it to a subcontractor.

Keeping core trades in-house gives tighter control over quality, cost, and programme, and fewer handoffs on site.
